false_cognates.why: both are called a 'zone' but denote unrelated things: an availability zone is a physical fault domain of the fabric (power/pod boundary); a security zone is a policy grouping of workloads in the overlay. They share no reference category and must not be corresponded - the cross-domain false cognate the ad-hoc reference is built to pre-empt.
